Architect the creative engine as a system: concept pipeline, testing taxonomy, briefs, hook/hold analytics, UGC, and whitelisting. Design capital allocation on marginal return rather than platform-reported averages. Design promo architecture across the retail calendar: pulse strategy, financing offers, funnel alignment. Identify, evaluate, and pilot paid channels beyond Google and Meta. Structure the performance marketing function itself. Shape the future of performance marketing at Puffy, where paid media is the primary growth lever. What Is In It For You: This isn't just another performance marketing role. Creative runs as a system you architect: concept pipeline, testing taxonomy, briefs, hook/hold analytics, UGC, whitelisting. You hold profitability to a contribution-margin standard after returns and financing costs, not ROAS in isolation. Embrace Radical Flexibility Work from anywhere in the world with meaningful time zone overlap. Your output is your credential, not your location. 4. Become the Operator Other Brands Try to Hire In most companies, performance marketing leaders inherit a system somebody else built and spend the next three years defending its numbers in meetings. Here you build it. When the CEO decides how much capital goes into growth next quarter, your model is the input to that decision, not a report on it afterwards. You'll leave with a paid media system you designed end to end, and the proof that it held contribution margin at scale, which is the part almost nobody in this function can actually show. Puffy has been AI-First since December 2023, so you'll build it with an AI-native toolbox behind you rather than an agency deck in front of you. What You'll Need: 7+ years in performance marketing with sustained ownership of $1M+/month on both Google and Meta (concurrently or across roles). "Ownership" means authority over strategy, structure, and budget, not just execution. Google depth at PMax-era: campaign structure, feed management, brand/non-brand economics. High-AOV considered-purchase experience ($1,000+ order values): sparse-conversion, long-decision-cycle categories. Personally built, not inherited, bid, budget, and pause decision systems at scale. You'll be asked to present a playbook you authored. Statistical decision literacy: volume gating, false-kill vs. wasted-spend trade-offs, threshold derivation, incrementality test design. Creative testing systems at scale in a post-ATT environment: concept-vs-variation discipline, creative analytics. Team leadership including senior direct reports. Experience building or restructuring a performance marketing function. Structured approach to new channel evaluation: selection frameworks, pilot design, budget allocation, and kill criteria. Good-to-Have: Scripting against Meta/Google APIs; Google Ads Scripts. Mixed agency + in-house background. Experience with emerging paid channels (e.g., TikTok, Connected TV, affiliate/partnerships, etc.). D2C e-commerce background in home goods, furniture, or comparable high-AOV verticals. The Puffy DNA: We're restless, perpetually hungry, and fast-paced, driven by an unwavering belief that we can outperform any competitor, regardless of their size. Be the Owner: We don't hire employees; we welcome owners. You're accountable for results, not activity. Execute with Urgency: We thrive in high-stakes environments by making thoughtful decisions quickly and acting decisively. Go All-In: When the mission demands it, we rally as one team to cross the finish line. ✨ Your Total Compensation & Benefits: 💰 Compensation: Total Annual Package: Up to USD $240,000 + comprehensive benefits (Base salary + monthly performance bonus of up to 20% of base) Annual salary review every January 🏥 Health & Protection: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance (based on country of hire) 🌴 Time Off: Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) + Public holidays 💼 Work Environment: AI-First organization with access to AI-native tool stack Remote First: Work from the comfort of your home office Learning & development opportunities International team collaboration across 16+ nationalities. Your assumptions get challenged daily. 🏆 Rewards & Recognition: Eligibility for selection to the Leaders Club, an elite recognition program featuring premium wellness memberships, exclusive networking with senior leadership, and annual leadership retreats Eligibility for nomination as 'We Are' Champion of the Month, monthly recognition with gift vouchers and company-wide celebration for exceptional contributions Ready to Shape Your Story?
